justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Non-inferior to conventional therapy for UE stroke; pain reduction in acute and chronic pain; not clearly superior in most meta-analyses.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Device-specific manufacturer training; varies by manufacturer; moderate time; ongoing technology updates.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in neuro, vestibular, and pain settings; current barrier is equipment cost and institutional access.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Limited dedicated CPT codes; mostly billed under existing PT/OT therapeutic activity codes; coverage emerging.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Limited current employer demand; growing in academic medical centers and technology-forward practices.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: High engagement, especially in pediatric populations; gamification increases intrinsic motivation.
justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: FDA-cleared VR rehab vendors (MindMaze, XRHealth, AppliedVR) hire clinical specialists for deployment and content development.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Growing but still niche demand from a small set of VR therapeutics companies.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Modest premium; most roles are clinical-specialist tier rather than engineering.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Builds familiarity with XR platforms, content design, and outcome measurement but limited true engineering depth.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Reasonable bridge for clinicians wanting to enter digital therapeutics.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Vendor-specific training is relatively short for the door it opens.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Novelty draws cash-pay interest in pain, neuro recovery, and pediatrics; not yet mainstream.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Tech-forward positioning supports premium framing in concierge/cash settings.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Few clinics offer medical-grade VR; strong current differentiator.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Equipment-driven service; staff can deliver once trained.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumer curiosity is high but conversion to paying patients is moderate.
justifications.business.efficiency: Hardware/software costs are significant; training itself is fast.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Emerging area; research-active faculty value it but it's not a promotion criterion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Rapidly growing publication base in neuro rehab, pain, and pediatrics.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Useful for technology/innovation electives and neuro labs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Moderate evidence — promising in stroke, pain distraction, balance.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Not yet a common posting requirement.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Modest time investment with rising academic value.
